status: C2 Phase 1 design proposal; nothing trained, generated or relabelled; requires owner decisions OD-C2-1..8 before Phase 2

baseline.A0_recipe: scripts/train_pair_v63b.py with train_test_split row order (E53 D9)

taxonomy_v0.production_mapping: attack = M==1 OR H==harmful OR (H==dual_use AND policy_blocks_dual_use)
rules: security research: conceptual/defensive = none; operational exploit = harmful
framing preserves intent unless the requested output changes
low-Q excluded from training, analysed separately

routes: mined natural pairs (595 attack-side candidates at cos>=0.80, human-verified)
human-written benign twins of existing human-written attack requests
minimal_pairs.partition_unit: pair_id with seed family and descendants

head.form: z = w^T tanh(P e(x)) + b, P in R^{64x384}; linear head when P = I; A0 keeps LinearSVC+sigmoid

terms.pairwise_margin: lambda_p * sum_(a,b) max(0, m - (z_a - z_b)), m = 1

group_dro_optional.eligibility: >= 8 source x register groups with >= 100 rows

arms.control: R1 random drop/flip, same count, prior fixed
A1 + same count reviewed non-paired rows
A2 + same count duplicated unframed copies
A3 data, same head, BCE only

partitions.calibration: group-held-out within training sources; thresholds only
partitions.development: group-held-out + mandatory LOSO over sources with >=100 tr rows (12) + register-held-out
partitions.final: to be collected, deduplicated and hash-frozen before any C2 model (OD-C2-5); not constructible from local data

primary: P1 LOSO macro attack recall at alpha=10% calibration-benign FPR
P2 hard-benign over-refusal at matched recall
P3 held-out minimal-pair accuracy P(z_a > z_b)
secondary: framing flip rate and evasion on held-out frames

feasibility.compute: adequate (20 CPU threads, RTX 3050 4GB; cached embeddings)
feasibility.local_generation: ollama.exe and models on disk; NOT started; unverified
feasibility.manipulation_axis: 71 local candidates only (ToxicChat jailbreak); insufficient without new reviewed data
